stations.title: Ailsa
stations.say: Callouts per hill, for the council?

stations.title: Callout log
stations.text: A year of lines, counted off with a pencil.

captions: At the radio desk, Ailsa asks for the callouts per hill for the council's yearly return.
Today she counts a whole year of the log off by hand, with a pencil, every January.
You count with a Counter, rank the busiest, and group dates by hill with a defaultdict.
Now the return fills itself in: callouts per hill, the busiest, and the dates on each.
Ailsa sends the council its answers in minutes, and her pencil stays in the drawer.
